Component.description: Replaces legacy System (§4). Execution host and interface container.

modes.description: Vendor-owned canonical mode definitions for this component. Functions may only reference a subset of these mode IDs.
modes.title: Modes

ports.description: Dedicated interface endpoints for connection edges and ontology predicates.
ports.title: Ports

Component.title: Component

Connection.description: A directed edge between two ports transmitting one signal.

connection_type.description: Project profile type: physical, logical, control, data, status, etc.

signal.description: Signal ID transmitted by this connection. One connection carries one signal.
signal.title: Signal

Connection.title: Connection

Function.description: Unified hierarchical function entity (§7). No system/component-level split.

component_id.description: ID of the component this function is allocated to, if already allocated.
component_id.title: Component Id

modes.description: References to Component.modes[*].id where this function is allowed to execute.
modes.title: Modes

parameters.description: Typed function parameters with name and type.
parameters.title: Parameters

function_description.description: Required free text describing function behavior for SI mapping. Include applicable standards and references (e.g., DNV-RP-0684 Annex A, SysML v2, or domain-specific standards) with relevant version, section, and constraint details.
function_description.title: Function Description

Function.title: Function

Mode.description: Vendor-defined component mode definition, referenced by functions.

id.description: Stable mode key such as remote or power.
id.title: Id

description.description: Required free-text semantics for the mode.
description.title: Description

Mode.title: Mode

Parameter.description: Typed parameter entry on a function.
Parameter.title: Parameter

kind.description: Defaults to vendor; also supports integrator, shipowner, shipyard, analytics_provider, class_society, operator.

Port.description: First-class interface endpoint on a Component (§6).

id.description: Vendor specific identification of the port, e.g. 'DI01'. Unique within parent component.
id.title: Id

module_id.description: Optional owning module. If set, it must exist in Component.modules[*].id.
module_id.title: Module Id

port_type.description: Required when direction=out; optional for in and undefined.

protocol.description: Required when direction=out; optional for in and undefined.
protocol.title: Protocol

Port.title: Port

schema_version.description: PEP 440 version string identifying the schema version this document was authored against. Must not exceed the current package version.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

category.description: command, permission_interlock, feedback, safety, mode, monitoring.

attributes.description: scaling, sampling, fail-safe, redundancy, sync/async, compatibility.
attributes.title: Attributes

vendor_io_mappings.description: Per-vendor IO tag bindings (party_id, item, direction, terminals).
vendor_io_mappings.title: Vendor Io Mappings

assumed.description: Mark inferred values (true) vs. values extracted from vendor documentation.
assumed.title: Assumed

source_doc_ref.description: Provenance pointer to the source document or datasheet.
source_doc_ref.title: Source Doc Ref
